description: Parameters to instantiate an Optical Inspection OPCUA sensor

ipv4.description: The IPv4 address on which the OPC UA server runs.

port.description: The port on which the OPC UA server runs.

camera.description: The index of the camera USB device represented as /dev/videoX.

headless.description: Run in a headless (without X serer and display mode).

mode.description: Mode of operation. The default is to read data from camera device (default=0). If set to 1 then read data from network.

frame_width.description: The desired for capture frame width.

frame_height.description: The desired for capture frame height.

video_stream_port.description: The port on which oi-sensor-client can send video stream to us.

stable_frames.description: Number of consecutive frames a shape must be detected before it is published over OPC UA (1 disables debouncing).
